attribution.note: Zitron's own words, in his own byline post on Where's Your Ed At, dated 2026-08-18. He is not quoting anyone else.

semantics.note: 'Will almost-certainly' is high confidence about a definite outcome, so it is a scored forecast. Dropping the size clause is correct because it is hedged with 'likely'. The IPO-delay reason is kept as a qualifier, and the March 2027 horizon is kept.

contract.note: Reading 'have to raise' as a forecast of need, so that a missing round alone does not contradict it, is generous to the speaker. But this is the evaluator's reading, not the speaker's. Whether a closed round alone counts as support, or whether proof of need is also required, could decide the result. The flag saying interpretation does not determine the result looks understated.

output.rationale: The deadline (on or before 2027-03-31) is after the 2026-10-28 evaluation date, and there is no early-resolution rule. The packet has no evidence items. The one source it considered was not used: a secondary report of talks, not a closed round. Absence of a round before the deadline is not failure. The forecast cannot be scored yet.
